updates.background_zh: Anthropic 在 Claude 3 模型家族中首次引入了 Opus 与 Sonnet 两个层级。Claude 模型通过 claude.ai、Claude API、Amazon Bedrock 以及 Google Cloud 的 Model Garden 分发，默认上下文窗口为 20 万 token。Anthropic 的 Claude 订阅分为 Free、Pro、Max、Team 和 Enterprise 五档。
updates.background_en: Anthropic introduced the Opus and Sonnet tiers with its Claude 3 model family. Claude models are distributed through claude.ai, the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud's Model Garden, and have a default 200,000-token context window. Anthropic sells Claude across Free, Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans.
updates.market_impact_zh: Anthropic 的模型发布并不直接涉及任何加密资产，因此传导路径主要在情绪层面而非基本面：更强的前沿企业级模型会为 AI 叙事交易提供素材，影响 AI 智能体与去中心化算力类代币——这类资产的价格部分建立在企业级 AI 普及预期之上。加密市场与 Claude 本身不存在托管、供给或协议层面的关联。
updates.market_impact_en: There is no direct crypto-asset exposure to an Anthropic model release, so any transmission runs through sentiment rather than fundamentals: news of a stronger frontier enterprise model feeds the AI-narrative trade in AI-agent and decentralized-compute tokens, which are priced partly on expectations about enterprise AI adoption. Crypto markets have no custody, supply or protocol link to Claude itself.
